author: Hermen Hulst
authorTitleZh: Studio Business Group 首席执行官，Sony Interactive Entertainment
authorTitleEn: CEO, Studio Business Group, Sony Interactive Entertainment
memoDateZh: 2026-06-25（SIE 员工内部邮件，同日公开）
memoDateEn: June 25, 2026 (internal SIE email, published same day)
headlineZh: PlayStation Studios 就 Bungie 裁员与组织调整发布说明
headlineEn: PlayStation Studios update on Bungie workforce reduction

impacts.detailZh: 大幅裁员，受影响员工中包括 Destiny 团队的大部分成员
impacts.detailEn: Workforce reduction affecting most of the Destiny team

impacts.detailZh: 部分 Marathon 团队成员受影响
支持 Bungie 运营的 SIE 团队亦有裁员
impacts.detailEn: Reductions across SIE teams that support Bungie operations

rationaleZh: 过去数月与 Bungie 领导层审视工作室长期方向、开发优先级、资源需求及在 PlayStation 投资组合中的角色；在探索多种替代方案后，认为裁员是使资源与当前优先级和长期目标对齐的必要步骤。
rationaleEn: After months of review with Bungie leadership on long-term direction, priorities, resources, and portfolio role—and after exploring alternatives—Sony concluded a reduction was necessary to align resources with current priorities and long-term goals.
destinyNoteZh: Bungie 近期在 Destiny 2 更新中宣布，在最终 live-service 内容更新发布后开启新阶段；过去十年 Destiny 对玩家与行业影响深远。
destinyNoteEn: As Bungie noted in its recent Destiny 2 update, the studio begins a new journey after the franchise’s final live-service content update; a decade of Destiny left a lasting mark.
marathonNoteZh: Marathon 仍是投资组合重要部分；将继续支持团队在 Season 1/2 基础上推进，并孵化未来项目。
marathonNoteEn: Marathon remains an important portfolio title; SIE will continue supporting the team building on Seasons 1–2 and incubation for future projects.
supportNoteZh: 优先为受影响员工提供过渡支持，并在可能情况下于 SIE 及全球工作室网络中寻找机会。
supportNoteEn: Immediate priority is transition support for affected employees and, where possible, opportunities across SIE and its global studio network.
